newsitem.title: FINLAND: HARTWALL SAYS '96 SALES OUTPERFORM MARKET.
newsitem.headline: HARTWALL SAYS '96 SALES OUTPERFORM MARKET.

text.p: Finnish beverages maker Oy Hartwall Ab said in a statement on Wednesday its beer, soft drink and mineral water sales increased 1.6 percent year-on-year in 1996 to 371.8 million litres.
Total sales of beverages in Finland increased 0.8 percent last year to 689.4 million litres, Hartwall said.
Hartwall's beer sales rose 0.5 percent in 1996 to 213.0 million litres while total Finnish beer sales fell 1.9 percent to 407.4 million litres.
Finnish tax on beer is higher than in other EU-countries and Finns are buying ever more beer abroad, Hartwall said.

Its mineral water sales also outperformed the market, up 16.9 percent compared to 13.1 percent for the branch, while its soft drink sales fell behind, rising just 1.7 percent in 1996 compared with an increase of 4.0 percent for the branch, Hartwall said.
